    The Detroit Tigers vs. San Diego Padres game on Saturday, March 28, 2026, at 8:40 p.m. ET can be watched on
    Padres.TV and Detroit SportsNet (DSN). Streaming options include Fubo and the Detroit SportsNet streaming app. 
    Here are the best ways to watch the matchup: 
    • TV Channels: Detroit SportsNet (DSN) and Padres.TV.
    • Live Streaming: FuboTV carries Detroit SportsNet, and the Detroit SportsNet streaming app allows for direct subscriptions ($19.99/month).
    • Out-of-Market: MLB.TV ($29.99/month) is available for viewers outside the local market.
    • Radio: 97.1 The Fan (WXYT-FM) in Detroit and 97.3 The Fan in San Diego.
